summary: Strengthen workplace risk controls, incident learning, and safety reporting in five days. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: Safety leadership training helps safety managers, operations supervisors and health and safety advisers turn workplace risks into verified controls. Participants practise hazard assessment, selecting controls, investigating incidents and consulting workers, then review safety indicators and develop corrective-action plans using an Excel dashboard and ISO 45001:2018 principles.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who guide, operate, or evaluate occupational health and safety systems and need to turn leadership commitments into verifiable workplace controls.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of workplace health and safety practices or current responsibility for safety-related decisions is recommended. No programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access if you want to complete the digital indicator exercise; advanced AI analytics are introduced conceptually rather than implemented.
